Launcher exit closes fd 9 -> canonical (VALIDATION) or private (CONTROL) lease free while owned survivors remain. material_findings.title: Caller commands report echo's status, not the driver/launcher raw exit; wrappers ineffective or hazardous
material_findings.mechanism: bash -c 'cd X && bash Y; echo "exit=$?"' exits 0 always; failed cd is printed as the driver/launcher exit. timeout --foreground --kill-after N bash -c '...' with trailing echo forks the child, so TERM ends only the outer shell; if effective, --kill-after would KILL the lease holder (contradicts A-04)
